info.title: API.SH: MakerWorld
info.description: The MakerWorld API from API.SH: public MakerWorld data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
3D (or laser and cutting) models on MakerWorld with every filter of the site's search: keywords, sort (relevance, trending, boosts, newest, downloads, likes), category, model tags (featured, exclusive, CyberBrick, Maker's Supply, customizable, parametric), licence, printer, nozzle size and type, single or multi-colour, print time, weight, upload age and contest. Without keywords it browses the whole library. Each model: id, title, link, cover, likes, collections, downloads, prints, comments, boosts, tags, licence, featured/exclusive/official flags, contest placing, creation date and designer. NSFW-flagged models are left out. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/makerworld-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (optional; empty browses everything).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default with keywords), trending (default without), boosts, newest, downloads or likes.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: 3d (default) or 2d (laser and cutting models).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category ids from /makerworld/v1/categories, comma-separated (e.g. 400 Household, 701 Hand Tools).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Model tags, comma-separated: featured, exclusive, cb (CyberBrick), ms (Maker's Supply), custom (customizable), param (parametric).

parameters.name: license
parameters.description: Licences, comma-separated: CC0, BY, BY-SA, BY-ND, BY-NC, BY-NC-SA, BY-NC-ND, Standard Digital File License.

parameters.name: printer
parameters.description: Printer codes with a print profile, comma-separated: BL-P001 X1 Carbon, BL-P002 X1, C13 X1E, N6 X2D, C12 P1S, C11 P1P, N7 P2S, N1 A1 mini, N2S A1, N9 A2L, O1C2 H2C, O1D H2D, O1E H2D Pro, O1S H2S, N10 H3C.

parameters.name: nozzle
parameters.description: Nozzle diameters, comma-separated: 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8.

parameters.name: nozzle_type
parameters.description: Standard, High Flow or TPU285 (comma-separated).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: single (single-colour profiles only) or multi (multi-colour only).

parameters.name: print_minutes
parameters.description: Print time range in minutes, min-max (e.g. 30-120; 600- for 10 hours or more).

parameters.name: weight_grams
parameters.description: Filament weight range in grams, min-max (e.g. 1-50; 500- for 500 g or more).

parameters.name: created_within_days
parameters.description: Uploaded in the last N days.

parameters.name: contest_id
parameters.description: Entries of one contest (ids from /makerworld/v1/contests).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (1-50, default 20).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass `next_offset` back here; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
